description: Every litellm_* Prometheus metric the LiteLLM proxy emits, one panel per metric family, grouped by theme.

panels.description: Total number of requests made to the proxy server - track number of client side requests
panels.title: litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric rate

panels.description: Total number of failed responses from proxy - the client did not get a success response from litellm proxy
panels.title: litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric rate

panels.description: deprecated - use litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric. Total number of LLM calls to litellm - track total per API Key, team, user
panels.title: litellm_requests_metric rate

panels.description: deprecated - use litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric
panels.title: litellm_llm_api_failed_requests_metric rate

panels.description: Number of HTTP requests currently in-flight on this uvicorn worker
panels.title: litellm_in_flight_requests

panels.description: Time (seconds) from request arrival at the proxy to the start of pre-call processing -- includes authentication and any ASGI-level queueing
panels.title: litellm_request_queue_time_seconds p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: End-to-end latency (seconds) for a request to LiteLLM Proxy Server, from the moment the request reached the proxy through the end of processing -- includes authentication, pre-call hooks, the LLM API call, and post-call processing
panels.title: litellm_request_total_latency_metric p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Total latency (seconds) for a models LLM API call
panels.title: litellm_llm_api_latency_metric p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Time to first token for a models LLM API call
panels.title: litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Latency overhead (seconds) added by LiteLLM processing
panels.title: litellm_overhead_latency_metric p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: LLM Deployment Analytics - Latency per output token
panels.title: litellm_deployment_latency_per_output_token p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Total spend on LLM requests
panels.title: litellm_spend_metric rate

panels.description: Total number of input + output tokens from LLM requests
panels.title: litellm_total_tokens_metric rate

panels.description: Total number of input tokens from LLM requests
panels.title: litellm_input_tokens_metric rate

panels.description: Total number of output tokens from LLM requests
panels.title: litellm_output_tokens_metric rate

panels.description: Provider-side cached input tokens (e.g. OpenAI prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, Anthropic cache_read_input_tokens)
panels.title: litellm_input_cached_tokens_metric rate

panels.description: Reasoning tokens reported in completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens
panels.title: litellm_output_reasoning_tokens_metric rate

panels.description: Number of images generated, from the image generation response
panels.title: litellm_images_generated_metric rate

panels.description: Total number of LiteLLM cache hits
panels.title: litellm_cache_hits_metric rate

panels.description: Total number of LiteLLM cache misses
panels.title: litellm_cache_misses_metric rate

panels.description: Total tokens served from LiteLLM cache
panels.title: litellm_cached_tokens_metric rate

panels.description: Total prompt/input tokens read from provider prompt cache (e.g. OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Bedrock)
panels.title: litellm_provider_cache_read_input_tokens_metric rate

panels.description: LLM Deployment Analytics - The state of the deployment: 0 = healthy, 1 = partial outage, 2 = complete outage
panels.title: litellm_deployment_state

panels.description: LLM Deployment Analytics - Total number of LLM API calls via litellm - success + failure
panels.title: litellm_deployment_total_requests rate

panels.description: LLM Deployment Analytics - Total number of successful LLM API calls via litellm
panels.title: litellm_deployment_success_responses rate

panels.description: LLM Deployment Analytics - Total number of failed LLM API calls for a specific LLM deploymeny. exception_status is the status of the exception from the llm api
panels.title: litellm_deployment_failure_responses rate

panels.description: LLM Deployment Analytics - Number of times a deployment has been cooled down by LiteLLM load balancing logic. exception_status is the status of the exception that caused the deployment to be cooled down
panels.title: litellm_deployment_cooled_down rate

panels.description: LLM Deployment Analytics - Number of successful fallback requests from primary model -> fallback model
panels.title: litellm_deployment_successful_fallbacks rate

panels.description: LLM Deployment Analytics - Number of failed fallback requests from primary model -> fallback model
panels.title: litellm_deployment_failed_fallbacks rate

panels.description: Deployment RPM limit found in config
panels.title: litellm_deployment_rpm_limit

panels.description: LLM Deployment Analytics - remaining requests for model, returned from LLM API Provider
panels.title: litellm_remaining_requests_metric

panels.description: remaining tokens for model, returned from LLM API Provider
panels.title: litellm_remaining_tokens_metric

panels.description: Total number of failures when emitting logs to callbacks (e.g. s3_v2, langfuse, etc)
panels.title: litellm_callback_logging_failures_metric rate
Redis circuit breaker (needs a Redis cache)
Spend log cleanup job (needs spend log retention enabled)

panels.description: p95 latency per internal service: redis, postgres, router, auth, batch writes, budget reset, proxy pre-call hooks and the proxy itself (self)
panels.title: Service latency p95 (litellm_<service>_latency)

panels.description: Requests per second handled by each internal service
panels.title: Service request rate (litellm_<service>_total_requests)

panels.description: Failed requests per second per internal service, split by exception class
panels.title: Service failure rate (litellm_<service>_failed_requests)
